MTD survey cushion widens from Day 18's +2.96% to +4.37% (trucks 396,676 BCM / survey 414,797 BCM), the strongest MTD position since Day 9. 3. 5. A new Week 29 Geotechnical Hazard Map lands with two unscored hazard IDs (HZ-ADW-032, HZ-ADW-033) not yet in the June 2026 risk register, and a location conflict on HZ-ADW-030 — the new map places it on the 760 crest / 735 toe, while both the June register and the Week 24 map place the same ID on the 770 crest / 740 toe. 6. Following the KB's 30-day production-month convention, July 13 is production day 19 of 30 — 11 days remaining. 7. HZ-ADW-030's location conflict needs a direct check with the geotechnical engineer — either mining has progressed a bench since June and the register is stale, or the map has reused an ID on a distinct, adjacent hazard. 8. HZ-ADW-032 and HZ-ADW-033 carry a hazard description and action on the map but no likelihood/consequence score, control status, or owner — worth confirming they land in the next register refresh rather than staying field-marked only. 9.
